content.title: How Jesus Became God: The Exaltation of a Jewish Preacher from Galilee
content.author: Bart D. Ehrman (New York: HarperOne, 2014)
content.note: An agnostic historian argues that some followers of Jesus had visions of him after his death and that this produced the belief in his resurrection; he doubts that Jesus received an honourable burial in a known tomb, and holds that a historian as such cannot conclude that a miracle happened.
